【Good Partner in Daily Life】This Android 14 tablet has 128GB ROM + 8GB RAM + 512GB additional expansion, which can store more games, movies, videos, music and work software for you, so you no longer have to worry about insufficient memory and other problems. It also supports Netflix, Facebook, Tik Tok, Youtube and other software, which greatly enriches your daily life. This tablet will become a good partner in your daily life.

【Wireless Communication】This 2 in 1 tablet features built-in Bluetooth 5.0 and supports 5G/2.4G dual band WiFi. Compatible with a wireless mouse and Bluetooth keyboard, it easily converts to laptop mode. Its highly customizable design allows for easy use in cafes, offices, bedrooms, and more. Its strong reception ensures a consistent connection, allowing you to work, chat with family, and connect with friends anytime, anywhere.

【Battery Life Upgrade】This 10.1 inch Android tablet is equipped with an 8000mAh upgraded battery, providing you with longer usage time without worrying about battery loss. You can watch videos for up to 10 hours, play games for up to 8 hours, and listen to music for more than 12 hours, giving you more entertainment time and Internet time.

【Ultra-Clear Design】This 10.1 inch tablet computer has an ultra-clear LCD screen, 1280x800 narrow-edge screen professional design, equipped with 13MP+8MP dual high-definition cameras, presenting you with richer picture display, clearer portrait capture, more delicate detail depiction, large screen Soft light curtain can reduce the visual pressure on your eyes and relieve fatigue.

【Exquisite Tablet】This 2 in 1 tablet has an exquisite appearance, efficient performance, easy and convenient operation interface, and excellent cost-effectiveness. It can be paired with a variety of accessories to achieve efficient work experience. It is suitable for all kinds of people and is definitely an ideal choice for students, teachers, housewives and business people.
